item.text: I’ll do one more behavior-preserving cleanup in the CLI: separate “produce sorted values” from “format output” so `main` only coordinates input and printing. It is small, but it makes the console boundary easier to test.
I’m adding a tiny formatter function and routing `main` through it. This keeps printing behavior unchanged while making output formatting an explicit unit.
The formatter extraction is done. I’m running the suite and console checks to make sure output stayed byte-for-byte the same.
